summary: Full backend + frontend testing for PGP Course Change Request Portal. Wrote pytest suite covering auth/RBAC, student-privacy, capacity-privacy, submissions (ADD/DROP/ADD_DROP), full swap workflows (reject path + accept->approve->execute), conflict 409, window close/open, admin dashboard/capacity/requests, Excel export (xlsx signature + no secrets), CSV import preview+commit, and audit log. All 22 backend tests PASS (100%). Frontend smoke: injected localStorage session_token and verified student dashboard (Welcome + PGPID + courses table + window banner, NO capacity fields leaked), Submit page shows exactly the 5 required options, My Requests populated, Notifications page renders, admin sidebar contains all 10 expected links, admin capacity table renders admin-only columns (Current/Min/Max/Pending Adds/Pending Drops/Net/Projected).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~920 lines — recommend splitting into modules (auth, student, admin, imports, exports) for maintainability.

compute_capacity() counts DROPs for BOTH sides of a swap as decrements from their current section AND ADDs to their requested section — this is correct for section swaps but for COURSE swaps the projection is symmetric which is fine; however cancelling admin decision path does not re-notify partner separately and there is no dedicated CANCELLED->notification flow (minor).
cancel_request forbids CANCELLED for APPROVED_PENDING_EXECUTION which is correct, but there is no admin 'revoke approval' endpoint if execution needs to be undone (product decision).
import_commit uses upsert-by-pgpid on students but relies on staged data — if courses/sections are edited between preview and commit results could drift (staleness). Consider re-validating on commit.

CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True — technically browsers reject wildcard with credentials, but regex matches actual Origin so it works; still, tightening to preview + prod origins is safer.
test_credentials: Bearer admintest_session (admin), Bearer stu_PGP001, Bearer stu_PGP002 — from /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ student via import preview+commit (TESTPGPX01 testx@iim.ac.in). Multiple TEST_ requests created and either cancelled by cleanup fixture or reached terminal EXECUTED status during swap-accept test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_pgp_portal.py. IMPORTANT: run with `-n 0` (no xdist parallelism) because the autouse cleanup fixture cancels any active PGP001/PGP002 requests to avoid 409 conflicts and would race with concurrent swap tests. Backend URL comes from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend session injection uses localStorage.setItem('session_token', <token>) then navigate to a protected route — works cleanly in the preview URL (no iframe partitioning at the top level). All business rules verified: (1) no capacity fields in student endpoints, (2) admin approve rejected with 400 while partner_confirmed is null, (3) approve => APPROVED_PENDING_EXECUTION (no enrollment mutation) and separate 'executed' step, (4) window closed blocks student POST with 403, (5) duplicate active request => 409.
